title: Browser tools for the second-dose model: adult shelter cats and dogs
description: Interactive browser models that estimate the second doses of modified live vaccine a shelter gives per case averted in adult cats (panleukopenia) and dogs (distemper, parvovirus), from a shelter's own length-of-stay records and case counts or from illustrative stays, and the effect of the day the second dose is given. They accompany Kreisler RE, DeTar L, Mavrovouniotis ML. The direct benefit of a second modified live core vaccine for adult shelter dogs and cats: a decision-analytic model. Submitted to BMC Veterinary Research.
